allow: Bash(python -c "import cuml; print(''cuML (RAPIDS) available''); from cuml.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier; print(''GPU RandomForest available'')")
Bash(python -c "import xgboost as xgb; print(f''XGBoost version: {xgb.__version__}''); print(''XGBoost available'')")
Bash(powershell -Command "Get-Process | Sort-Object CPU -Descending | Select-Object -First 15 ProcessName, CPU, WorkingSet, Id | Format-Table -AutoSize")

Bash(powershell -Command "Get-Process | Where-Object {$_CPU -gt 10} | Sort-Object CPU -Descending | Format-Table ProcessName, @{Label=''CPU(s)'';Expression={[math]::Round($_CPU,2)}}, @{Label=''Memory(MB)'';Expression={[math]::Round($_WorkingSet/1MB,2)}}, Id -AutoSize")
Bash(powershell -Command "Get-Counter ''\Processor(_Total)\% Processor Time'' | Select-Object -ExpandProperty CounterSamples | Select-Object -ExpandProperty CookedValue")

Bash(powershell -Command "$processes = Get-Process | Where-Object {$_CPU -gt 0}; $totalCPU = ($processes | Measure-Object CPU -Sum).Sum; $processes | Select-Object ProcessName, @{Name=''CPU_Seconds'';Expression={[math]::Round($_CPU,1)}}, @{Name=''CPU_Percent'';Expression={[math]::Round(($_CPU/$totalCPU)*100,2)}}, @{Name=''Mem_MB'';Expression={[math]::Round($_WorkingSet/1MB,0)}}, Id | Sort-Object CPU_Seconds -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 | Format-Table -AutoSize")
